The Müngstener Brücke is the highest railway bridge in Germany and is frequented by RB 47 "Der Müngstener" every 30 minutes. This picture was taken in March 2013, one week before the bridge was closed due to changing the steel beams. When the bridge is reopened, silver multiple units of Abellio instead of the red DB Class 628 coaches will be on the way here.
